name: Joker
text: Absorbs one incorrect action. Does not cover a timer expiry.

name: Shield
text: Absorbs one failure of any kind, including a timer expiry.

name: Freeze
text: No new rules for 3 turns. The turn counter continues.

name: Chaos
text: A random rule from the pool becomes active.
visualCue: Purple ripple — a random card materializes

name: Mirror
text: The previous rule activates again with a fresh duration.
visualCue: Card echo — the previous rule duplicates back

name: Echo
text: Restores a specific past rule. The only way back for a dead rule.

name: Time Warp
text: The next 5 turns run on shorter timers. The difficulty multiplier still applies.
visualCue: Speed lines intensify — the timer bar compresses

name: Rule Bomb
text: Removes one random active rule. Can remove an Identifier Rule.
visualCue: Explosive pop — a rule card shatters
